acceptance_scenarios.name: Healthy stock - no action required
acceptance_scenarios.description: Stock coverage comfortably exceeds target. System should return NO_ACTION and not call vendor tools.
acceptance_scenarios.condition: Available units provide >20 days of coverage when target is 14 days

acceptance_scenarios.name: Missing request data
acceptance_scenarios.description: Warehouse or SKU is absent from request
acceptance_scenarios.condition: SKU field is null or empty
expected_behaviors: System asks for specific missing field
No database queries until data is provided
Clear error message points to 'sku' field

acceptance_scenarios.name: Stale inventory snapshot
acceptance_scenarios.description: Inventory data is older than 2 days
acceptance_scenarios.condition: Snapshot captured_at is more than 2 days old

acceptance_scenarios.name: Cost versus speed trade-off
acceptance_scenarios.description: Cheapest vendor arrives after stockout; costlier vendor arrives earlier
acceptance_scenarios.condition: Multiple vendor options with different costs and lead times
expected_behaviors: Proposal explains trade-off using tool evidence
Shows why faster vendor is recommended despite higher cost
Human can see both options with arrival dates

acceptance_scenarios.name: Over-budget proposal
acceptance_scenarios.description: Lowest-cost option exceeds remaining monthly budget
acceptance_scenarios.condition: Total cost of cheapest eligible option > budget remaining
expected_behaviors: Policy-guided review detects the over-budget concern
If normal path blocked, may offer higher-cost slower option
Proposal clearly marked with budget exception flag

acceptance_scenarios.name: Invalid model output
acceptance_scenarios.description: Agent omits required field in structured output
expected_behaviors: Pydantic validation fails on agent output
One repair attempt via prompt refinement
If still invalid, fail closed with BLOCKED status

acceptance_scenarios.name: Approval data changes during pause
acceptance_scenarios.description: Budget or vendor offer changes while waiting for human approval
acceptance_scenarios.condition: Changes occur between approval request and revalidation
expected_behaviors: External system modifies budget or offer
Case re-enters risk assessment with new facts

acceptance_scenarios.name: Duplicate approval handling
acceptance_scenarios.description: Same approved proposal is resumed twice by mistake
acceptance_scenarios.condition: Graph re-enters purchase request creation with same case_id and proposal_hash

acceptance_scenarios.name: Human rejection
expected_behaviors: Audit event logs REJECTED with approver_id and timestamp
Case can be revised and re-submitted

acceptance_scenarios.name: Database write failure
acceptance_scenarios.description: purchase_requests table is locked or database error occurs
expected_behaviors: Exception is caught and error code returned
No partial data left in database

acceptance_scenarios.name: New SKU with insufficient sales history
acceptance_scenarios.description: Product has < 3 observations in required time windows
acceptance_scenarios.condition: Sales records < 3 for both 7-day and 30-day windows
expected_behaviors: Recommends manual input or waiting for more history

acceptance_scenarios.name: Unreliable vendor with expired offer
acceptance_scenarios.description: Only vendor offer is from unreliable vendor or has expired
acceptance_scenarios.condition: Vendor reliability < 0.90 OR offer valid_until < now
